how_to_apply: Applications will be received online only. The online Recruitment Portal will be available from 1400 hrs on 29.09.2026 to 1400 hrs on 13.10.2026 on the LPSC website. The direct application link is not given in the notification text provided.
Visit the online Recruitment Portal on the LPSC website.
Fill in the online application form with complete and correct details, including a correct email ID.
Upload a photograph as per the specifications given below.
Upload the certificates and mark sheets related to the prescribed essential qualifications for the post.
Submit the application and note down the online registration number.
Pay the application fee online, either immediately after submission or later, up to 1400 hrs on 14.10.2026.

The notification says candidates need not send any documents to LPSC, including application printouts, copies of certificates or payment receipts, after successfully completing the online registration.
Applications in which the applicant cannot be clearly identified from the uploaded photo, or in which malware is detected in the uploaded photo, will be considered invalid.

Candidates can apply for more than one post, but those intending to do so should apply separately for each post. LPSC reserves the right to conduct the examination for two or more posts simultaneously, as per administrative requirements.
In case of duplicate or multiple applications, only the latest application for which the application fee has been received within the last date of payment will be considered.
Applications submitted without complete information, photo, etc. as specified will be summarily rejected.

Candidates registered on the National Career Service (NCS) portal and fulfilling the eligibility conditions may apply through the online recruitment portal on the LPSC website, following the same application procedure.

Candidates working in Central/State Government, Public Sector Undertakings, autonomous bodies, etc. have to apply under intimation to their present employer. They must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of the interview or when called for by LPSC/ISRO. A candidate who fails to submit the original NOC at the time of the interview will not be permitted to appear for the interview.

Candidates must produce original documents at the time of the interview as proof of the details given in the application. Those who fail to do so will not be allowed to attend the interview, will not be paid Travelling Allowance and will have no claim to participate in the further recruitment process.

Details of the written test, interview, etc. will be intimated through email or the LPSC website only. LPSC will not be responsible for non-communication due to a mistake in the email ID provided by the candidate.
Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.
Travelling allowance, train fare or bus fare will not be paid for attending the written test.

Outstation candidates called for the interview will be paid to-and-fro Second Class railway fare by the shortest route on production of the ticket, if they are not availing the concession offered by Indian Railways.
Women candidates are encouraged to apply, as the Government strives to have a workforce that reflects gender balance.

content_sections.heading: LPSC Scientist Engineer Recruitment 2026: Quick Summary
content_sections.text: Who is recruiting? Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre (LPSC), ISRO, Department of Space, Government of India. Which posts? Scientist Engineer 'SC' in Welding (Post No. 820), Turbo Machinery (Post No. 821) and Power Electronics (Post No. 822). How many vacancies? 01 vacancy for each of the three posts, which adds up to 3 vacancies. All posts are Un-Reserved. Who can apply? Indian nationals holding the prescribed B.E./B.Tech and M.E./M.Tech qualifications as on 13.10.2026, with a maximum age of 30 years as on 13.10.2026. Application start date: 29.09.2026 (Tuesday) from 1400 hrs. Last date to apply: 13.10.2026 (Tuesday) up to 1400 hrs. Application mode: Online only, through the online Recruitment Portal on the LPSC website. Job location: LPSC, Valiamala, Thiruvananthapuram. Candidates may be posted to any ISRO/Department of Space Unit or Centre in India as required.

content_sections.heading: LPSC Scientist Engineer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: To be eligible, a candidate must meet the nationality, qualification and age conditions given in the notification. Only Indian nationals need apply. Only candidates who possess the required qualifications as on 13.10.2026 need apply. The maximum age limit is 30 years as on 13.10.2026. The essential qualification should be from a recognised university or institution. The prescribed qualification for each post must have been completed within the stipulated duration of the course as prescribed by the university. Candidates who have pursued a professional course through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) are not eligible for consideration.

content_sections.heading: LPSC Scientist Engineer Qualification
content_sections.text: Each post requires both a B.E./B.Tech degree and an M.E./M.Tech degree in the specified branches. The notification uses the word "AND" between the two requirements. If a university mentions both CGPA and percentage of marks in the degree certificate or consolidated mark sheet, at least one criterion (either CGPA or percentage) should meet ISRO's eligibility norms. If a university mentions only CGPA, that CGPA must meet DOS/ISRO's eligibility criteria. Converting CGPA into a percentage of marks to decide eligibility is not permitted, even if the university has prescribed a conversion formula. The same criteria apply, with necessary changes, where only a percentage of marks is mentioned. Rounding-off of marks is not allowed. Candidates holding degrees from foreign universities should produce the equivalency certificate issued by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU), New Delhi at the time of the Personal Interview. Where the certificate mentions CGPA or percentage separately for graduation and post-graduation, the graduation and post-graduation CGPA or percentage will be reckoned as per the existing procedure. Where a single CGPA or percentage applicable to the entire course is mentioned, that final figure will be used to decide eligibility. Where the university does not prescribe any CGPA or percentage in the dual/integrated degree certificate, the cumulative CGPA or percentage in the final/consolidated mark sheet for the entire course will be used. These criteria apply uniformly, whether or not a university prescribes a formula to derive the CGPA or percentage for graduation or post-graduation.

faq.question: Q1. What is the full form of ISRO LPSC?
faq.answer: ISRO LPSC stands for Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre, a premier research and development center under the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), located in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced in the ISRO LPSC 2026 notification?
faq.answer: A total of 3 vacancies have been announced for the Scientist / Engineer - 'SC' posts across different specialized engineering disciplines including Welding, Turbo Machinery, and Power Electronics.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ISRO LPSC Scientist/Engineer recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application portal opens on 29 September 2026, and the final date to submit the completed online application form is 13 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for ISRO LPSC Scientist/Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E/B.Tech or equivalent degree with minimum 65% marks alongside an M.E/M.Tech or equivalent degree with minimum 60% marks in the relevant engineering disciplines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit to apply for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all applicants is 30 years as of the last date of application submission, 13 October 2026, with age relaxations applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the ISRO LPSC Scientist/Engineer 'SC' role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed under Level 10 of the Pay Matrix with a lucrative salary ranging from Rs. 56,100 to Rs. 1,77,500 per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required for ISRO LPSC recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification released by the Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre for these particular posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ISRO LPSC Scientist / Engineer - 'SC'?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises submitting an online application, initial screening of candidates based on academic records, followed by a personal interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. How can candidates apply for the ISRO LPSC recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply exclusively through the online mode by visiting the official website www.lpsc.gov.in and completing the online registration before the deadline.
